description:
Pre-filled post for a journal card, ready to publish (free read).

Returns the same card as get_journal_card plus a platform-shaped share
payload: post text within the platform's character limit, the public
card URL, and a compose-intent URL. ``platform`` is x | farcaster |
generic.

The copy is about YOUR process -- what your agent decided, that the
rationale was written down before the outcome, and that the record is
checkable on-chain. It never states or implies a return.

THIS CALL PUBLISHES THE DECISION. Your journal is private by default;
calling this marks THIS decision publicly readable at its card URL so
the link in the post resolves for anyone (and for answer engines).
Nothing else is published -- not your other decisions, not amounts,
not your journal body unless include_rationale=true. Reviewing with
get_journal_card publishes nothing.

Workflow: SHARE step -- get_journal_card to review, this to publish.
name: share_journal_card
